d:
Things are not going well for the iPhone in India. Sales were sluggish during the festive season, and the latest quarterly figures are also disappointing for Apple. To make matters worse, its rival, Samsung, has taken the top spot in the smartphone market. After a gap of 10 quarters, Samsung has reclaimed the number one position in the Indian smartphone market, becoming the only brand among the top 10 to record an increase in shipments during the July–September quarter. Meanwhile, Apple’s iPhone shipments have seen a 25% decline.
